**Section:** Cariyāpiṭaka (cp)  
**Collection:** Sutta  
**Title (Pali):** Nimirājacariya  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0512m.mul0.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0512m.mul0.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

In a study comparing the canonical accounts of the *Cariyāpiṭaka* with the Jātaka corpus, André Bareau catalogues the text under the title *Nimi-rāja-Cariyam*, recording it as the sixth story in the collection following *Mahā-Govinda-Cariyam* and preceding *Canda-kumāra-Cariyam* [Bareau, Les récits canoniques].

**Sources**

- [Bareau, Les récits canoniques] André Bareau, Les récits canoniques du Cariyāpiṭaka et les Jātaka Pāli — variant spelling/title Nimi-rāja-Cariyam and sequential position within the collection
